text:
Alex (procure): FYI vendor called with an updated lead time and an RMA that hit customs, needs routing decision.
Maria (infra): details? which vendor and which depot?
Alex (procure): Vendor_JP, AWB 771-555-230, serials show 3 H100s flagged DOA on arrival. They want to split replacement air vs sea.
Vendor_JP: apologies, confirmed 3 units failed POST at our staging depot — photos uploaded. We can air-replace 2 units and sea-replace 1 to reduce cost. Broker fee applies for air.
Sam (ops): can we accept air-replace for 2 into SFO enclave? customs hold might add 48-72h.
Li (eng): cluster capacity next week is tight in us-west2, if 2 come in we should schedule immediate provisioning to avoid regressions. Maria, can we pre-allocate slots?
Maria (infra): we have 4 free slots on dedicated pool but need lead time for image bake and network ACLs. 24h if we prioritize.
Alex (procure): pricing: vendor quoted air-replace + brokerage = +$2.1k per unit. Sea replace is covered under warranty with zero unit cost but 2x longer ETA.
Sam (ops): decision tradeoff: pay $4.2k extra to recover capacity in 48-72h vs waiting 14-21 days. What’s the cost of missing service SLO? ops-estimate: ~ $15k/day in token-latency penalty for critical routes.
Vendor_JP: we can expedite customs paperwork if Redwood signs broker waiver form (attached).
Alex (procure): attached: invoice snippet and broker waiver. Snippet: 
```
INVOICE LINE: AWB 771-555-230 | 2x H100 air-replace | broker fee $4200 | expedited customs handling $450
```
Sam (ops): need legal/finance signoff on broker waiver asap. @Maria can infra take 24h prep if we greenlight air?
Maria (infra): yes, 24h prep is feasible if we get confirmed ETA and AWB update. Network change window tomorrow 2am-4am PT acceptable.
Li (eng): if we provision early, can we hot-swap into dedicated pool without rolling rest of fleet? recommend canary: route 10% traffic initially.
Alex (procure): action items: 1) Legal/Finance review waiver (Sam loop in finance) 2) Vendor_JP confirm AWB/ETD 3) Maria schedule bake 4) DepotBot to create RMA ticket and attach photos.
Sam (ops): looping in @Finance now, forwarding invoice.
DepotBot: New RMA created: RMA-7821 | AWB 771-555-230 | photos attached | current status: customs_hold.
Vendor_JP: thanks — we’ll hold off physical replacement until waiver signed. If waiver not signed within 8h, we will default to sea replace for all 3.
Alex (procure): understood. Finance + Legal please advise within 6h so we can avoid full sea delay. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria (infra): prepping bake checklist, will post when done.
Li (eng): prepping canary rollout plan.
Sam (ops): finance replied: routing to BillingOps for emergency approval, ETA 4h. I’ll update thread. :thumbsup:
